text:
maria: FYI — planning a Private VPC installer push tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for the onprem image loader hotfix.
aj: Which image tag are we pinning? release-2026-03-20-hotfix1?
samir: Yes, pin to `release-2026-03-20-hotfix1`. Found a race when the image cache misses during startup on older kernels. Repro in staging.
caroline: Security OK with cosign sigs + KMS key rotation, but need the signer fingerprint in release notes.
maria: Good. Also need shrinkwrap manifest updated and the airgap bundle checksum. I'm going to lock the transport window at 02:15 UTC.
ops-lucy: I'll run the transport. Will verify checksums and cosign before handing to the carrier.
aj: Pushing new submanifest. Diff:
```
- images:
-  - redwood/onprem:release-2026-03-20
+ images:
+  - redwood/onprem:release-2026-03-20-hotfix1
  installer:
    sha256: <new-sha256>
```
maria: deploy-bot, queue canary for vpc-canary-3 at 02:20 UTC, 5 nodes, 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary queued by maria for `release-2026-03-20-hotfix1` on vpc-canary-3 at 02:20 UTC. Will report status here.
ops-lucy: Quick checklist for transport handoff:
- generate signed submanifest
- cosign sign submanifest
- upload sealed bundle to s3://private-transit/
- notify carrier
samir: For rollback, plan is to pin back to `release-2026-03-18-stable` and withdraw the hotfix tag from mirrors. Timebox rollback 15m.
caroline: Add note in release notes: "Hotfix: fix onprem image loader race; cosign key fpr: ABCD:1234..." Also recording KMS rotation step.
maria: OK — final signoff?
aj: +1 from pkg.
samir: +1 staging green.
caroline: +1 security.
maria: proceeding with transport at 02:15 UTC. Will update here with cosign and checksum artifacts.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:20 UTC on vpc-canary-3. Monitoring logs. Alert if error rate > 2%.
deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 10m. No regressions detected.
maria: Rolling to full Private pool at 02:35 UTC unless objections within 5m.
aj: no objections, go.
ops-lucy: Transport uploaded: s3://private-transit/releases/release-2026-03-20-hotfix1.tar.gz
ops-lucy: Cosign sig: sha256:abcd1234...
ops-lucy: Carrier notified, ETA transfer complete 02:45 UTC.
maria: Closing thread — release notes published in docs, changelog entry created, and rollback plan recorded in the incident board. :tada:
